name: Adelaide Scuba
summary: Adelaide Scuba is an SSI dive centre in Glenelg North with two dive boats berthed behind the shop. It runs guided boat dives to reefs and wrecks off Adelaide, and a double dive on the Ex-HMAS Hobart from Wirrina Cove. Courses run from Try Dive and Open Water to Advanced, Rescue and a range of specialties, taught in an on-site heated pool and on the boats.
standouts: SSI Dive Centre with its own dive boats berthed behind the shop
Two vessels: Reefknot (a 1986 Randell) and Abracadabra (a 2002 Steber twinscrew)
Private on-site heated dive pool, with classes of 4 students
A double boat dive is guaranteed with every Open Water course

trips.title: Boat Diving
trips.summary: Guided boat dives from Glenelg North on Reefknot or Abracadabra, both berthed behind the Adelaide Scuba dive centre. Guests arrive at the private car park, check in, set up their equipment and board. Reef sites such as Seacliff Reef and Craggle Rock suit Open Water divers, wrecks such as The Dredge and MV Seawolf are also listed, and deeper sites are marked for Advanced Open Water divers.
highlights: Reef and wreck sites marked for Open Water or Advanced Open Water divers
Led by Adelaide Scuba instructors and dive guides
Private car park, with the boats berthed behind the dive centre
Toilets, hot and cold showers, tea and coffee and Shark Shields on board

trips.title: Diving the Ex-HMAS Hobart
trips.summary: A double boat dive on the Ex-HMAS Hobart, a former Royal Australian Navy guided missile destroyer scuttled as a dive wreck in 2002. The boat leaves from the Wirrina Cove fuel jetty rather than Glenelg, and divers must have logged a dive in the past 3 months. Any rental gear, including cylinders, has to be collected from the dive centre before the tour.
highlights: Double dive on the Ex-HMAS Hobart wreck
Departs from the Wirrina Cove fuel jetty
A dive logged within the past 3 months is required
Rental gear and cylinders are collected from the shop beforehand
trips.duration: A double dive is usually a full day

trips.title: Open Water Diver
trips.summary: The SSI Open Water Diver course, the entry-level certification, run over three days after SSI eLearning at home. Day one is a private session in the on-site heated pool, and days two and three are two boat dives each from the dive boats berthed behind the shop. Classes are limited to 4 students, and certified divers can dive to 18 metres.
highlights: SSI Open Water Diver certification, to a depth of 18 metres
SSI eLearning at home, one pool day and four boat dives
Private heated pool with no lane sharing
Classes of 4 students
trips.duration: 3 days after SSI eLearning at home; each day starts at 9am and finishes about 3pm

trips.title: Junior Open Water Diver
trips.summary: The SSI Junior Open Water Diver certification for younger divers, with the same core skills and safety rules as the Open Water Diver course but set depth and supervision limits. Training is SSI eLearning at home, pool or confined water sessions, then open water dives with an SSI instructor. Junior divers can upgrade to Open Water Diver on turning 15 without retaking the course.

Depth and supervision limits for younger divers
Certified juniors can dive with a buddy and from a boat
Upgrades to Open Water Diver at age 15 with no need to retake the course

checkNotes: No trip or course price appears anywhere on the site: prices sit inside Rezdy booking widgets and calendars, which were not opened, so prices is empty for every trip. The only dollar amounts on the site are daily gear hire rates, gas fill and servicing prices on the Services & Facilities page, and a $100 reschedule fee in the course FAQ. Gear hire rates are recorded as optional add-on price options on the two boat trips where divers hire gear, with priceFrom null. Course FAQ (identical on all 13 course pages): rescheduling within 14 days of the course start costs $100, eLearning is not refundable once started, and vouchers can be put towards a Learn To Dive course. All booking links are on adelaidescuba.rezdy.com. The boat dive BOOK buttons go to a Rezdy monthly calendar (productsMonthlyCalendar/657278). The menu 'Calendar' (productsMonthlyCalendar/557971) and 'Join the Dive Club' (rezdy.com/667321/dive-club) were left out because they are menu links into the booking system with no described trip. Course pages embed Rezdy widgets in iframes, so those trips carry the course page URL as the booking link. SSI or PADI: the courses are SSI and the Boat Diving page calls the centre an SSI Dive Centre, but the footer logo is a PADI logo (alt text 'PADI Logo'), the drysuit booking link is named 'padi-drysuit-course', one photo caption mentions a PADI instructor and the team list includes an SDI/TDI instructor; confirm which agencies they teach. The home page calls the centre award winning without naming an award, so it is not repeated. Left out as not trips: gear rental, servicing, gas fills, pool hire for film and photo shoots, retail (the Shop page says coming soon) and the Dive Club. Try Dive, Refresher and Pool Workshops are swimming pool sessions with no ocean dive and are flagged on each trip in case they should be dropped. Shop hours: closed Monday and Tuesday, 9:00 to 17:00 Wednesday to Sunday. The Terms and Conditions page is unfilled template text ('Company Name', 'Website.com'). The email address is hidden behind Cloudflare obfuscation on the pages and was decoded from the page source; it matches on the home, contact and Services & Facilities pages. No YouTube or Vimeo channel is linked from the site. Left off the page as pool-only, not on the sea: Try Dive, Refresher, Pool Workshops.
